passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: Engrossed text: a single-subject constitutional amendment whose one operative section is the marriage definition.

rows.reasoning: Lehman co-authored HJR 3 (2014) and voted Yea on its House third reading (Yea 57 Nay 40), a single-subject joint resolution whose sole operative section would write into the state constitution that "Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana." That is the rung that would "Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman": it bars any same-sex marriage from being valid in Indiana and fixes the one-man-one-woman definition. The rung allowing civil unions while reserving marriage is excluded, because the resolution recognizes no same-sex status at all.
